dct_description_sm: Environment and Climate Change Canada (ECCC) operates thirty-three (33) aerological observing stations throughout Canada, thirteen (13) of these are considered to be in the Arctic region. The collected data are of limited availability to the public, and PDC intends to make this data openly available to our users, for additional reuse. There are few vertical profile studies around the world, and so archiving data from this program is novel, especially in the Arctic region, where climate change is escalating faster than other southern regions.
dct_title_s: Vertical Air Profile in the Canadian Arctic, 2012-2020
